# The Arcane Archives

> The Arcane Archives is a private community founded by Leo Gray for people done with surface-level advice, with an education vault behind it. Members get a room of people doing the work (private channels, leaderboard and ranks), a weekly live call with Leo (the War Room), a daily quest, and 3,330+ modules across 46+ complete protocols on psychology, business, health, investing and trading education. Membership is £128 a month, cancel anytime, and entry is by a short 12-question assessment.

Key facts:

- Name: The Arcane Archives (also "Arcane Archives")
- Website: https://arcanearchives.shop/
- Founder: Leo Gray, an ex-chef from Essex, England, who has spent £80,000+ learning how money, systems and people work and has built and broken 7+ ventures
- Type: private community with an education vault (paid membership)
- Price: £128 per month (about £4.21 a day), no contract; standalone protocols from £29.99
- Entry: 12-question assessment, about 3 minutes; instant access if cleared
- Content: 3,330+ modules, 46+ protocols, four realms
  - Mind & Psychology (18 protocols): mindset, stoicism, mental models, discipline, dark psychology
  - Wealth & Business (17 protocols): entrepreneurship, copywriting, sales, personal brand
  - Health & Investing (5 protocols): health, biohacking, training, investing
  - Systems (6 protocols): trading education, deep work, efficiency, daily quests
- Community: private channels, leaderboard, ranks from Seeker to Arcane Master, Arcane Credits for referrals
- Tools: the Trading Floor (live charts beside lessons) and the Watchtower (global intelligence dashboard)
- Not financial, investment or medical advice; all content is education only
